'''J'Quille''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] hunter who served in [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] court during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was a former lover of [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Valarian/Legends|Valarian]] and secretly worked as a spy for her in Jabba's presence. He was heavily prone to paranoia. He was also known be a great fighter because of his hunting skills.

==Biography==
===Valarian's lover===
J’Quille was a [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] hunter who lived<ref name="CharEnc" /> and was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on<ref name="Force Collection J'Quille" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Toola/Legends|Toola]].<ref name="CharEnc" /> He was a lover of the Whiphid [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] Lady [[Valarian/Legends|Valarian]], who owned the [[Lucky Despot]], a highly successful [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Whiphid'sTale" /> She was the main rival<ref name="CharEnc" /> of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] crime lord who also operated on Tatooine.<ref name="Whiphid'sTale" /> Valarian constantly plotted to have the Hutt [[Death/Legends|killed]], using J'Quille as her main assistant in these endeavors. Valarian, however, realized she would be killed should any assassination attempts be traced back to her.<ref name="FF119" /> The two Whiphids staged a falling out and breakup which led to Jabba employing the former as<ref name="CSWE" /> a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]<ref name="CharEnc" /> to gall Valarian.<ref name="CSWE" /> 

J'Quille was given his own quarters in Jabba's Tatooine [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]], located near the pit of [[Jabba's rancor/Legends|Jabba's rancor]].<ref name="Whiphid'sTale" /> He spied on the Hutt and planned his [[Death/Legends|death]]<ref name="CharEnc" /> through the kitchen boy [[Phlegmin]],<ref name="Whiphid'sTale" /> whom the Whiphid bribed<ref name="FF119">{{FactFile|119|JAB 25-28|Jabba the Hutt}}</ref> to put slow-acting poison in Jabba's snack tank of [[Toad/Legends|toads]].<ref name="Whiphid'sTale" /> By [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="Blackmail">J'Quille receives the blackmail note two days before the events of "[[Let Us Prey: The Whiphid's Tale]]", which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> The poison began to take effect, and Jabba started to suffer from indigestion.<ref name="FF119" /> In that year,<ref name="Blackmail" /> J'Quille received an anonymous blackmail note that showed his bribes to Phlegmin. The Whiphid hunter paid a sum of ten thousand credits to the blackmailer, who was actually Phlegmin.<ref name="Whiphid'sTale" />

===Palace arrivals===
Two days later,<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|VI}} to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> J'Quille was present inside the throne room of the Palace,<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> chatting with the [[Yarkora/Legends|Yakora]] [[Saelt-Marae/Legends|Saelt-Marae]]<ref name="I60">{{InsiderCite|60|Who's Who in Jabba's Palace}}</ref> in a booth when two [[Droid/Legends|droids]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] were led into the room by Jabba's [[Majordomo/Legends|majordomo]] [[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]]. R2-D2 displayed a [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] message of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] for Jabba, in which Skywalker bargained for the release of the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], who was being kept frozen within [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] in the palace. The Hutt declined the offer, and the two droids were taken down to<ref name="ROTJ" /> [[Cyborg Operations]].<ref name="Cyborg">{{CSWECite|I|157|Cyborg Operations}}</ref>

Shortly after, J'Quille was again in the throne room, sitting in a booth behind the<ref name="ROTJ" /> [[Elom/Legends|Elom]] [[Tanus Spijek/Legends|Tanus Spijek]]<ref name="Tanus">{{CCG|set=Jabba's Palace Limited|cardname=Tanus Spijek}}</ref> while the [[Max Rebo Band/Legends|Max Rebo Band]] the dancing girl [[Oola/Legends|Oola]] preformed. Jabba demanded that Oola, repeat her performance. However, [[Joh Yowza/Legends|Joh Yowza]], a singer for the Max Rebo Band, thought Jabba was demanding him to preform again and the band performed again. When Oola was fed to Jabba's rancor for refusing to sit with him,<ref name="JN">[[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi (junior novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'' junior novelization]]</ref> J'Quille cheered and raised his arms, but did not get up to look at Oola get eaten.<ref name="JN" /> 

As several court members watched Oola's death, the sudden sound of [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire rang from the main entrance of the palace. [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], disguised as the bounty hunter [[Boushh/Legends|Boushh]], and her captive, [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] entered and faced Jabba. Organa announced she had come for the bounty on the Wookiee and then brandished an activated [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] when her request for more [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] from Jabba was denied, causing<ref name="JN" /> J'Quille<ref name="ROTJ" /> and several others in the throne room to take cover. After a tense silence fell on the throne room, Jabba agreed to pay a larger amount and Organa deactivated the detonator.<ref name="JN" /> [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] guards [[Ortugg]] and [[Rogua]] then took the Wookiee away down to the palace dungeons.<ref name="And Then There Were Some: The Gamorrean Guard's Tale">{{StoryCite|story=And Then There Were Some: The Gamorrean Guard's Tale|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}}</ref> 

[[File:JabbasPalaceDenizens-SWI129.jpg|thumb|left|210px|J'Quille with other members of [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's criminal empire]]]]
Later, J'Quille got an anonymous message from someone who claimed to know who was behind the blackmailing, who told him to meet them on the [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|citadel]] roof at sunfall. On his way to meet this stranger he noticed a shifty B'omarr Monk whom he'd seen near the kitchen when Phlegmin was found dead. Unbeknownst to J'Quille, the corrupt, embodied monk was working for Lady Valarian and had been trying to inform J'Quille that Phlegmin was in fact the blackmailer. However, J'Quille misinterpreted Valarian's comment about a B'omarr monk, and believed that the monk had been blackmailing him. After a misunderstanding, the Whiphid hunter stabbed the monk with his [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibro-blade]], which had been a gift from Lady Valarian in the first place.

In the monk's hands was the [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] used by [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] Leia Organa (as [[Boushh/Legends|Boushh]]). He planned to make up for his mistakes to Valarian by planting the detonator on [[Khetanna/Legends|Jabba's sail barge]], but it was soon stolen from him by [[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]]. After Jabba's death, J'Quille attempted to return to [[Toola/Legends|Toola]], only to discover that Lady Valarian had put a huge bounty on his head if he ever left the planet Tatooine. With nowhere else to go, he returned to Jabba's Palace and joined the B'omarr Monks having his brain removed from his body.

==Personality and traits==
J'Quille was a brutal Whiphid who had coarse fur.<ref name="CharEnc" />

==Behind the scenes==
J'Quille was portrayed by mime artist [[Tim Dry]].

In ''[[Return of the Jedi Monster Activity Book]]'', this character was nicknamed "Tooth Face". After the movie release, [[Troy Denning]] named the species "Whiphid" in ''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]'', and Tooth Face the individual's name, J'Quille, was revealed in ''[[Tales from Jabba's Palace]]''.
